course_title: Special Topics in Chinese: The Art of Early China
subject: CHN
course_description: Study of Chinese language, literature, society, thought, or culture, alone or in conjunction with other literary or cultural trends. Topics to be announced in advance.
course_notes: (Same as ARTHIST 289W 1, ANT 285W 1) "The Art of Early China"What can ceramic, jade, bone, bronze, stone, or silk tell us about life and history in early China? How might modern archaeology complicate the traditional descriptions of Chinese culture? In what ways do contemporary biases inform our interpretations of the ancient material remains? This course explores significant works of art from the Neolithic period, the Bronze Age, and the early imperial periods (ca. 200 CE). We will closely analyze objects unearthed through archaeological excavations and compare them with related historical texts. Readings drawn from both academic scholarship and popular literature will complement our weekly lectures and discussions. Art History major / minor: Div. I or IV
